description: This PHP source file defines a DataGenerator class used for generating, populating, and cleaning up test data in a database, including handling parent records and sequences. It includes methods for setting default values, tracking generated tables, and managing primary key references.

classes.name: DataGenerator
classes.description: A class providing methods for generating, inserting, and cleaning up test data in a database, including handling parent records and sequences.

methods.name: generateOne
methods.description: Generates a single record and returns its ID.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates multiple records, optionally creating parent records, and returns their IDs.

methods.name: generateParents
methods.description: Creates parent records based on defined relationships if not already set.

methods.name: cleanUp
methods.description: Deletes all generated data from tracked tables and resets sequences.

methods.name: getReferenceId
methods.description: Stores or retrieves primary key IDs for ancestor records.

methods.name: trackData
methods.description: Tracks tables where data has been generated for cleanup purposes.

methods.name: addAncestor
methods.description: Recursively creates ancestor records with primary keys.

methods.name: setDefaultValues
methods.description: Populates a DataObject with default or pre-set data.

methods.name: getFieldValueFromDataContainer
methods.description: Retrieves pre-set data for a specific field.

methods.name: defaultValueForObject
methods.description: Gets default value for a field based on DataObject settings.

methods.name: defaultValueByType
methods.description: Provides default values based on field type.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Sets data in the internal container for later use in record generation.

methods.name: setDataOne
methods.description: Sets a single value for a field in the data container.

methods.name: resetSequence
methods.description: Resets database sequence for a table to 1.
